source: Manual Codex critical judgement using Compass Q1 2026 Form 10-Q, April 2026 randomized tovecimig BTC release, ASCO 2026 CTX-8371 abstract, current ClinicalTrials.gov protocols and 2026 company disclosures; as of 2026-07-12

market_share_notes.CTX-009: INCLUDE BTC: randomized Phase 2/3 data showed ORR 17.1% versus 5.3% and PFS HR 0.44, supporting a Tier One profile, while the failed unadjusted ITT OS endpoint and crossover interpretation cap base peak at 12%. INCLUDE mCRC: Phase 2 activity was modest and non-randomized, so base peak is reduced to 3% pending a validated registration path.
market_share_notes.CTX-10726: INCLUDE GC: current Phase 1 protocol contains a gastric cohort; 1.5% base reflects pre-efficacy status. INCLUDE HCC: current Phase 1 protocol contains an HCC cohort; 2.0% base reflects large competition and no human efficacy. INCLUDE EC: current Phase 1 protocol contains an endometrial cohort; 1.2% base reflects early stage and crowded immunotherapy. INCLUDE RCC: current Phase 1 protocol contains an RCC cohort; 1.8% base reflects early stage and established VEGF/checkpoint standards.
market_share_notes.CTX-471: INCLUDE ES-SCLC: the active Phase 2 high-grade NCAM-positive NEN protocol can enroll advanced pulmonary small-cell disease, but approved DLL3/checkpoint competition caps base at 4%. INCLUDE LCNEC: rarity, high unmet need and biomarker selection support a 6% base, with no efficacy yet. INCLUDE EP-NEC: lack of targeted standards supports a 5.5% base, discounted for pre-efficacy Phase 2 status. Historical melanoma and mesothelioma signals are not separate active registration cohorts and are not forecast as current programs.
market_share_notes.CTX-8371: INCLUDE NSCLC: one response among the initial 15 evaluable patients supports retaining the active expansion cohort, but a crowded market caps base at 5%. INCLUDE TNBC: the durable initial response and active expansion support a 7% base. INCLUDE HL: post-checkpoint unmet need and an observed metabolic response support a 15% base in the small addressable segment. INCLUDE HNSCC: the registered expansion remains active but has no reported response, limiting base to 2%. INCLUDE MEL: the registered expansion remains active but has no reported response, limiting base to 2%.
